scenarios.title: Faculty Own Record Access
scenarios.description: Faculty users can access their own records only.
scenarios.details: Faculty user successfully accessed their own teaching workload records.

scenarios.title: Faculty Cross-Record Access Denial
scenarios.description: Faculty users cannot access another faculty member's private records.
scenarios.details: Access correctly denied when faculty attempted to access another faculty member's records.

scenarios.title: HOD Own Department Access
scenarios.description: HOD users can access records within their own department.
scenarios.details: HOD successfully accessed department-level analytics for their own department.

scenarios.title: HOD Cross-Department Access Denial
scenarios.description: HOD users cannot access another department's restricted records.
scenarios.details: Access correctly denied when HOD attempted to view another department's records.

scenarios.title: Admin University-Wide Access
scenarios.description: Admin users can access university-wide records.
scenarios.details: Admin user successfully accessed university-wide institutional workload comparison.

scenarios.title: Leave Approval Integrity
scenarios.description: Pending and rejected leave records are not treated as approved leave.
scenarios.details: Verified: All 1 filtered records strictly have approval_status='Approved'. Pending/Rejected leaves excluded.

scenarios.title: Policy Exception Override Integrity
scenarios.description: Pending and rejected policy exceptions do not override workload limits.
scenarios.details: Verified: Pending policy exception PEX002 (19.0 hrs) for FAC016 was ignored. Effective limit remains 16.0 hrs.
